task1.title: Annual Energy Consumption by Source in 2020
task1.prompt: The bar chart illustrates the annual energy consumption in terawatt-hours (TWh) for various sources in a specific country in the year 2020. The chart includes five primary energy sources: coal, natural gas, nuclear, wind, and solar. It is evident that natural gas was the dominant source of energy, accounting for approximately 40% of the total energy consumption at around 800 TWh. Coal followed as the second most significant source, contributing about 30% or 600 TWh. Nuclear energy had a moderate share of around 200 TWh, representing 10% of the overall consumption. In contrast, renewable sources such as wind and solar made up a smaller fraction of the total, with wind energy at approximately 100 TWh (5%) and solar energy slightly lower at around 80 TWh (4%). Overall, the data suggests a substantial reliance on fossil fuels, particularly natural gas and coal, while renewable sources still have a limited impact on the energy landscape in this period.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In recent years, the advancement of technology has revolutionized the way we communicate. While some argue that technology has adversely affected personal interactions, others believe it has improved communication significantly. Discuss both views and give your opinion. In today's fast-paced world, many individuals find it easier to connect through digital means, such as social media and messaging apps, rather than face-to-face conversations. Proponents of this view argue that technology facilitates communication across distances, allowing people to maintain relationships regardless of geographical barriers. However, critics contend that reliance on digital communication can lead to superficial interactions, where genuine emotional connections are often lacking. Additionally, the prevalence of smartphones and social media may contribute to a decrease in in-person social skills. In your opinion, does technology enhance or hinder effective communication? Provide reasons and examples to support your stance.
